guide.greenlantern.aquaman.title: Aquaman
guide.greenlantern.aquaman:
The next hero of the DC Universe is §bAquaman§r, the King of Atlantis.

§6The emblem§r
Craft the §6Atlantean Emblem§r (prismarine shards, gold and a nautilus shell). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the suit: the orange scale shirt, the green leggings and the boots (your helmet stays). One hero at a time: putting on one suit removes the others.

§6Son of the sea§r
With the suit you breathe underwater and see clearly in the deep. You are tougher, hit harder, mine fast underwater and ordinary falls don't hurt you.

§6Power of the Seas§r
The powers use the Power of the Seas (the wave bar). It refills quickly in the water, at half the rate in the rain and slowly on dry land.

§6Powers§r
With the suit, hold §eR§r for the power wheel (tap R for the next power) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the emblem) to use the selected power.
guide.greenlantern.kraken.title: The Kraken
guide.greenlantern.kraken:
The fifth power of the sea. Pick §6Kraken§r on the power wheel and press §eV§r: a 15 block tall Kraken rises from the deep (or out of the ground) right under you, and you ride on top of its head. It costs 400 Power of the Seas and needs open space around you.

§6Moving§r
On land it walks on its eight arms: slow and heavy, every step shakes the ground. §eW§r walks, §esprint§r is a heavy charge, §ejump§r is a leap that lands with a shockwave. It climbs two block steps and bursts through leaves.
In deep water it stretches out like a squid and races where you look: §eW§r speeds up, §esprint§r is a burst, §ejump§r rises. It can reach the surface but never leaves the water by swimming.

§6Attacks§r
§eLeft click§r: one of its two hunting tentacles rises over its head and slams down about nine blocks in front of it, crushing and throwing back everything around the blow (hold it to keep slamming).
§eHold right click§r: a powerful jet of water from its siphon, where you aim. It batters and pushes away everything along the stream and puts out fires. It drains 10 Power of the Seas per second.

§6Its own life§r
The Kraken has 400 life (see the bar under your powers). Monsters, arrows and explosions aimed at you hit the Kraken instead. In the water its wounds slowly heal. If its life runs out it dies, you fall off, and it needs 60 seconds to recover before it can be called again.

§6Off its head§r
§eSneak§r to climb off: it stays and fights the monsters around you on its own. Right click it to climb back on. Use the power again to call it back to you or, while riding, to send it back to the deep.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.aquaman_emblem: Prismarine shards in the corners, gold ingots on the sides and a nautilus shell in the center. The emblem starts without Power of the Seas: put on the suit and swim to fill it.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.0: Welcome to Atlantis, surface traveller. Take a deep breath... ah, right, you can't.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.1: The palace beacon shines all the way to the surface. That's how our children find their way home.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.2: The coral gardens have been tended for a thousand years. Please mind the anemones.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.3: The King spoke to the sharks this morning. They promised to behave.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.4: No gills? There's a respirator in the Pavilion of Portals for visitors from the surface.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.5: The bubble columns in the gardens rise all the way to the sky. The children love racing up them.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.6: They say the throne's treasure keeps the emblem of the kings of Atlantis.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.7: Ever seen a Green Lantern down here? Their green light scares the lanternfish.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.8: Surface dwellers throw too much into the sea. We keep the pretty shells.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.9: The copper towers turned green before we even sank. They match the kelp.
By the crown of Atlantis! No monster gets past our gates.
Move along, visitor. The royal guard is on patrol.
The King trusts his trident. We trust ours.
Drowned prowl the kelp slopes at night. Stay close to the light.
The palace is open to the people, but the throne's chests belong to the King.
You swim well, for a surface dweller.
power.greenlantern.atlantis_portal.desc: Opens a whirlpool that leads to Atlantis, at the bottom of the ocean. Opened in Atlantis, it takes you back to the exact spot you came from.
message.greenlantern.atlantis_missing: There is no Atlantis in this world (no deep ocean nearby, or it is turned off in the config).
message.greenlantern.atlantis_welcome: Welcome to Atlantis! You are in the Pavilion of Portals, which has air. The palace is just past the door.
message.greenlantern.atlantis_need_air: Outside it's all water: take an Atlantean Respirator (there's one in this pavilion's chest) before opening the door.
message.greenlantern.atlantis_portal: The portal to Atlantis is open: walk through it!
message.greenlantern.atlantis_portal_hom: The way back is open: walk through it to return where you came from!
message.greenlantern.respirator_low: The respirator is almost out of air: head for the surface!
message.greenlantern.respirator_empty: The respirator ran out of air!
tooltip.greenlantern.respirator_hint: Works from anywhere in the inventory, with any suit · refills out of the water
tooltip.greenlantern.atlantis_gate_hint: Right-click: opens a portal to Atlantis · in Atlantis, opens the way back
guide.greenlantern.atlantis.title: The city
guide.greenlantern.atlantis:
§bAtlantis§r, the sunken kingdom, is not another dimension: it lies at the bottom of a deep ocean of this very world, in a crater far below the sea floor, some way from spawn. Every world has its own, and it builds itself in the first seconds of play.

§6The city§r
The Royal Palace, a pyramid of dark prismarine and gold with the throne hall, and a beacon on top whose cyan beam rises out of the sea (that's how you find it when sailing). Two colossal statues of the King guard the entrance. Marble avenues with columns of light, eight towers with copper domes, glass-domed houses, coral gardens with bubble columns, the wall with four gates and slopes covered in kelp forests. Tropical fish, dolphins, turtles and glow squid swim everywhere, along with the creatures found only here: giant manta rays, giant seahorses and Atlantean dolphins (see Creatures of Atlantis).
guide.greenlantern.recipe.atlantis_gate: Gold ingots in the corners, prismarine crystals on the sides, a heart of the sea in the center and an ender pearl below. There is also one in the palace treasure.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.atlantean_resp: Prismarine shards, a gold ingot on top, kelp on both sides and a glass bottle in the center (the air tank).
power.greenlantern.kraken.desc: A 15 block tall Kraken rises from the deep and carries you on its head, on land (slow and heavy) and in the sea (fast). Left click: tentacle slam. Hold right click: water jet. It has its own life: it takes the blows aimed at you. Use the power again to send it away.
message.greenlantern.kraken_summoned: The Kraken rises from the deep!
message.greenlantern.kraken_no_room: There is no room for the Kraken here
message.greenlantern.kraken_recovering: The Kraken is still recovering from its wounds (%s s)
message.greenlantern.kraken_defeated: The Kraken has fallen! It needs %s seconds to recover
message.greenlantern.kraken_left: The Kraken went back to the deep
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_trident: The trident appears in your hand. It hits much harder than a diamond sword, knocks enemies back and splashes the ones around. Hold §eright-click§r and release to throw it: it flies straight, hits hard (harder in water and rain) and always comes back to your hand. Use the power again to call it back or send it away.
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_sea_call: The sea creatures around (fish, squids, dolphins, turtles, axolotls...) follow you and attack the monsters near you and whoever hurts you, for 30 seconds. If too few answer, dolphins come from the deep. Use it again to release them.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_people: Citizens swim between the houses and gardens; right-click to talk. The Royal Guard patrols the palace and the wall with tridents and drives off monsters. Look for the chests of the throne, the armory and the houses.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_travel:
§bAquaman§r has the §6Portal to Atlantis§r power (power wheel). Other heroes use the §6Atlantis Gate§r: right-click opens the same portal. You arrive in the §6Pavilion of Portals§r, a glass dome full of air with a copper door to the city. Open the portal again inside Atlantis and it takes you back to the exact spot you came from.

§6Portal to Atlantis§r
A whirlpool opens in front of you and leads to Atlantis, at the bottom of the ocean. Inside Atlantis, the same power opens the way back to the exact spot you came from.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_respirator: Hero suits can't be taken off and their masks hold the helmet slot, so the respirator is not armor: it works from anywhere in the inventory, like a totem, and clips on over the mask or helmet. Underwater it breathes for you (its air bar shows above the hunger bar) and holds 8 minutes of air, which refills quickly out of the water. Aquaman doesn't need it. The first visitor finds one in the pavilion's chest.
guide.greenlantern.controls_aquaman:
§eIn the water§r (suit on): go where you look; §ejump§r rises, §esneak§r dives, §esprint§r builds up speed.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eRight-click§r (hold, release) with the trident: throw it.
§eOn the shark§r: §eLeft-click§r lunge and bite, §eSneak§r climb off.

§6Creatures of Atlantis§r
§eRight-click§r the creature: ride. §eW§r speeds up, §esprint§r builds up to its top speed, §ejump§r rises, §esneak§r climbs off.
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_swim.title: Swimming
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_swim:
In the water you go where you look, as if flying: §eW A S D§r move, §ejump§r rises and §esneak§r dives.

§6Sprint swimming§r
Hold §esprint§r: the first kick sends out a swirl of bubbles and the speed builds up gradually, from the normal swim to a speed no fish can match, leaving a sea-green trail with spiralling bubbles. It starts gently, pulls hard in the middle and settles at the top speed. Let go and the swim slows down smoothly, with no jolt.

§6Dolphin leap§r
Race up through the surface and you leap out of the water like a dolphin.

§6Soundtrack§r
Once the swim gets going, the theme of the King of the Seas begins: harp, strings and the drums of the tide. As the speed builds up, the horns and the choir join in with the theme of Atlantis. It also plays riding the shark or the creatures of Atlantis. It follows the Music volume and can be turned off in §econfig/greenlantern-client.toml§r (the same option as the flight theme).
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_trident.title: Trident of Atlantis
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_shark.title: Great White Shark
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_shark:
In the water, a great white shark comes from the deep and you ride it. It swims where you look: §eW§r speeds up, §esprint§r is a burst, §ejump§r rises.

§6Lunge and bite§r
§eLeft-click§r: the shark strikes. It draws back, lifts its snout and opens its jaws wide, full of teeth, shoots forward and slams them shut on whatever is in front of it, shaking its prey from side to side. The screen shakes with the bite. Hold the button to strike again.

§6On its own§r
§eSneak§r to climb off: it stays around you hunting monsters (it lunges at them too); right-click it to climb back on. Use the power again to send it away.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_people.title: The Atlanteans
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_travel.title: Getting there
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_creatures:
Three creatures live only in Atlantis: the §bGiant Manta Ray§r, the §bGiant Seahorse§r and the §bAtlantean Dolphins§r. They swim around the city and the coral gardens, and §eany player§r can ride them, with or without a hero suit.

§6Riding§r
Right-click a creature to climb on. It swims where you look: §eW§r speeds up gradually, §eS§r brakes, §eA D§r drift to the sides, §ejump§r rises and §esprint§r builds up to its top speed. §eSneak§r to climb off.

§6The Atlantean bond§r
While you ride, the creature breathes for you: your air never runs out underwater.

§6Eggs§r
Every creature has an egg (in the §2DC Universe Heroes§r creative tab). Use the egg on the water to hatch it there, or on a block to hatch it on top. Name the egg in an anvil and the creature hatches with that name.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_manta.title: Giant Manta Ray
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_manta:
The largest creature of Atlantis: eight blocks from wingtip to wingtip. It beats its wings slowly, in a wave running from the body to the tips, and turns in wide, graceful curves.

§6Gliding§r
Race up through the surface and the manta leaps out of the sea with a beat of its wings. Hold §eW§r in the air and it glides over the water, sinking slowly and turning where you look, until it dives back in.

§6Colors§r
Abyssal (black with pale patches and cyan dots), Reef (blue with golden dots) and Coral (purple with turquoise dots). All of them wear an Atlantean saddle.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_seahorse:
The steed of the riders of Atlantis: nimble, quick to turn, swimming upright with its fins fluttering and its tail curled. At speed it leans forward and streams its tail out behind.

§6Tail kick§r
Starting a sprint, it kicks with its tail in a swirl of bubbles.

§6On land§r
Out of the water it hops on its tail: hold §eW§r or §ejump§r to bounce back to the sea.

§6Colors and patterns§r
Every seahorse is different: eight colors (coral, gold, purple, turquoise, pink, emerald, crimson and blue) and three patterns (plain, spotted and striped), all with the golden crown of Atlantis.
guide.greenlantern.atlantis_dolphin:
Bigger than the dolphins of the open sea, brightly colored, with bioluminescent markings that glow in the dark depths. They swim in pods and are the fastest mounts of the sea.

§6Trail of light§r
When they race, their markings leave a trail of light in the dolphin's color.

§6Leaps§r
Race up through the surface and the dolphin makes a high leap out of the water.

§6Colors§r
Azure, violet, magenta, gold, emerald and coral, each glowing in its own color.
tooltip.greenlantern.atlantean_egg: Creature of Atlantis: use on the water to hatch. Right-click it to ride.
